description: Comprehensive test suite covering all API endpoints, skills, pipeline logic, and error cases using httpx TestClient and pytest fixtures. Ensure every feature added in FEAT-001 through FEAT-003 has proper test coverage.
steps: Create tests/conftest.py - Shared pytest fixtures: (1) app_client fixture using httpx.AsyncClient with ASGITransport for the FastAPI app. (2) sample_project fixture that creates a project and returns project_id + user_id. (3) ingested_project fixture that creates a project, uploads a sample text file, and ingests it. (4) multi_doc_project fixture that ingests 2-3 different documents for comparison/multi-doc tests. (5) tmp data directory cleanup fixture.

Create tests/test_api_projects.py - Test project CRUD: (1) test_create_project_success. (2) test_create_project_missing_header returns 422. (3) test_create_project_short_name returns 422. (4) test_share_project_success. (5) test_share_project_not_owner returns 403. (6) test_share_project_not_found returns 404.

Create tests/test_api_upload_ingest.py - Test upload and ingestion: (1) test_upload_file_success returns fileId and jobId. (2) test_upload_unsupported_type returns 400. (3) test_upload_no_access returns 403. (4) test_ingest_file_success creates chunks. (5) test_ingest_file_not_found returns 404. (6) test_ingest_job_status. (7) test_upload_large_file returns 413.

Create tests/test_api_query.py - Test query/retrieval: (1) test_query_with_results returns answer and sources. (2) test_query_no_results returns 'I don't know' style answer. (3) test_query_with_file_filter. (4) test_query_user_mismatch returns 403. (5) test_query_no_access returns 403. (6) test_query_with_web_enabled. (7) test_query_with_conversation_context.

Create tests/test_api_skills.py - Test skill endpoints: (1) test_summarize_success. (2) test_summarize_no_files returns meaningful error. (3) test_compare_two_documents. (4) test_compare_needs_two_files. (5) test_extract_entities. (6) test_extract_facts. (7) test_extract_topics. (8) test_conversation_start. (9) test_conversation_message. (10) test_conversation_history.

Create tests/test_pipeline.py - Test pipeline internals: (1) test_chunk_document_overlap (verify overlapping chunks). (2) test_parse_content_text. (3) test_parse_content_csv. (4) test_parse_content_empty_file. (5) test_embed_similar_texts_score_higher (semantic similarity test). (6) test_embed_different_texts_score_lower.

Create tests/test_middleware.py - Test middleware: (1) test_request_id_header_present. (2) test_error_response_structured. (3) test_cors_headers_present. (4) test_rate_limiting (if feasible without real timing).

Create tests/test_skills_unit.py - Unit tests for skill modules: (1) test_summarizer_extracts_top_sentences. (2) test_comparator_finds_shared_themes. (3) test_extractor_finds_dates_and_values. (4) test_extractor_finds_emails_urls. (5) test_conversation_query_rewrite. (6) test_web_search_format_results.
Update tests/test_e2e.py - Fix deprecation warnings by updating datetime.utcnow() to datetime.now(datetime.UTC). Ensure existing tests still pass with the new architecture.
acceptance_criteria: python3.12 -m pytest tests/ -v shows all tests passing
At least 40 test cases across all test files
Every API endpoint has at least one success and one error test case
Every skill module has unit tests verifying core logic
Pipeline embedding quality is tested (similar texts score higher than dissimilar)
Tests use httpx TestClient with proper async handling for API tests
No test relies on external network calls (web search tests mock the HTTP calls)
findings: All 97 tests pass (up from original 21). Test distribution: test_api_projects (9), test_api_query (9), test_api_skills (13), test_api_upload_ingest (10), test_e2e (3), test_middleware (9), test_pipeline (9), test_skills (18), test_skills_unit (17). Files with local_path='' require writing actual temp files for summarize/compare tests that call parse_content. Web search tests all use unittest.mock.patch on requests.post. Rate limiting is disabled in test env via APP_ENVIRONMENT=test.
